messages.subject: Data from packages
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ian:
First, congratulations on getting the the Jhon Chambers Award, you have done a
great job with this package
Second, has the below been implemented?
I have the DeducerExtras package installed by default but don't see the new
menu.

Hi:
I read about Deducer when it first came out but I just  now gave it a
 try. I have to say that it is
 a great way for newbies to plot their data without having to type or
 know anything about R. I do have
 a couple of questions though;
 1 - Is there a way to see the code generated when a user clicks on the
 any of the menus?

 The code is sent to the console when you hit 'Run', so you can see it
 there. In the plot builder there is a menu item 'view call' that
 displays the generated code.

 2- Rcmdr has a dropdown combo box where the user can select datasets
 from loaded packages to practice; does Deducer have that option? If
 not, could that be included?

 There currently is not, but it is very easy to implement. Here is the code:

 .makePackageDataDialog <- function(){
     dat <- data()$results
     RFunction <- J("org.rosuda.deducer.widgets.param.RFunction")
     RFunctionDialog <-
 J("org.rosuda.deducer.widgets.param.RFunctionDialog")
     ParamCharacter <- J("org.rosuda.deducer.widgets.param.ParamCharacter")

     rf <- new(RFunction,"data")
     rf$setTitle("Load Data From Package")

     p <- new(ParamCharacter,"data")
     p$setTitle("Data set")
     p$setOptions(dat[,3])
     p$setLabels(dat[,4])
    p$setViewType(p$VIEW_COMBO)
     rf$add(p)

    rfd <- new(RFunctionDialog, rf)
     rfd$setSize(250L,125L)     rfd$setLocationRelativeTo(.jnull())
    rfd
}
jgr.insertMenuItem("File","Load Package Data Set",
                     ".makePackageDataDialog()$run()",3)

 I will include this dialog in the next version of the DeducerExtras package.

 Ian

Felipe D. Carrillo
Supervisory Fishery Biologist
Department of the Interior
US Fish & Wildlife Service
California, USA
